c74object.name: mUnit.harness
c74object.digest: Configure mUnit.handler from munit.config.js and open a folder of test patches
c74object.description: mUnit.harness points mUnit.handler at your munit.config.js and, with loadFolder, opens a folder of test patches, so one patch runs a whole suite. Connect its outlet to the handler's inlet. It runs when its patch opens; the patch must be saved, since its folder is where the configuration and the tests are found.
c74object.discussion: Without loadFolder it only loads the configuration. By default every matching test patch is opened at once and closed when the suite has finished; with sequential they run one at a time. The test patches need no handler or harness of their own: their asserts register with the running handler, and mUnit.loadbang fires in each once the handler is ready.

outlet.digest: Messages for mUnit.handler; connect to its inlet
outlet.description: Sends hydrateConfiguration, reset and, in sequential mode, hold, mark and done.

attribute.name: loadFolder
attribute.description: Relative to the harness's patch; absolute paths work too. Every file matching pattern is opened. Without it, only the configuration is loaded.

attribute.name: configFolder
attribute.digest: The folder with munit.config.js (default: the patch's folder)
attribute.description: Relative to the harness's patch. The file is read fresh each time the patch opens; without it, the defaults apply and the results go to logs/ in that folder.

attribute.name: pattern
attribute.description: A glob: * and ? work, e.g. test_*.maxpat. Files starting with a dot are skipped.

attribute.name: sequential
attribute.digest: Open one test patch at a time (default 0)
attribute.description: Opens a patch, waits until its asserts have finished, closes it, then opens the next. Slower, but patches can't interfere with each other through shared send/receive names, DSP state or CPU load. Each patch's mUnit.teardown fires before that patch is closed; the result files are written once at the end.

entry.name: anything
entry.description: Out the outlet: messages for mUnit.handler; connect it to the handler's inlet. Sends hydrateConfiguration, reset and, in sequential mode, hold, mark and done.
